tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshe sgrub zab mo'i las gzhung mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

/bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dbang sgrub thabs ni/ gnas dben par yo byad sogs dbang gzhung ltar 'du byas la/ bgegs la gtor ma brngan te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du hrīḥyig dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod sems can thams cad kyi tshe'i bar chad bsal/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob cing snang ba mtha' yas kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog padma rā ga'i mdog can zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan zhing zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rin po che margad mchog gi*/lhung bzed 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams shing*/ dbu skra bung ba nag po ltar gnag pa'i thor tshugs las phyed rgyab tu 'phyang ba/ rin po che du ma'i dbu rgyan dang*/ snyan rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub/ mgul rgyan dpung rgyan se mo do ske rags dang do shal gyis mdzes pa| dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ me tog dmar po'i rgyan gyis kun nas brgyan pa/ shin tu bzang po'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur| slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur sku gang chu lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ bha ga wa te ā yurdzñā na de wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs sbyar nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/

hrīḥ 'od mtshan rab 'bar padma rā ga'i mdog /'dzum zhing bzang po'i ngang tshul 'jo sgeg ldan// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan// mnyam par bzhengs shing ral pa'i thor tshugs can// phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar bar dag tu// margad mdog gi lhung bzed 'chi med kyi// bdud rtsis gang bas tshe'i dngos grub stsol// brgyad gnyis na tshod mtshan dpe'i dra bas brgyan// 'od dpag med pa'i bka' rtags cod pan can// bcom ldan tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi tshe dang lha mi'i snod bcud thams cad kyi dpal 'byor bsod nams thams cad bsdus te rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par mos te/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ arte/ brte/ ku nante/ ta ke/ tha ke/ ta ra ke/ hi li/ mi li/ saṃ bhakṣa/ bhi bhakṣu/ si santu/ na mo bha ta ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// de dag ni bdag gi rnal 'byor ro// mdun bskyed ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su thod pa dang bdud rtsi'i nang du padma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod bar bdag bskyed ltar bsgoms la/ rang dang mdun bskyed tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros stong gsum gling phran thams cad dang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs tshe dang dpal 'byor thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed tshe dpag med kyi lhung bzed kyi nang du byung bas gang zhing phyir lud pa/ thod pa tshe chang dang ril bu dang gzhan yang tshe'i yo byad thams cad la thim pas/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub skad cig la stsol nus pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur/

ces dmigs te bzlas pa bya/ skabs skabs su mchod cing bstod la bzlas pa la 'bad/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe mchod cing bstod la/ rgya gar nas byon pa'i bla ma dā na shrīs gnang ba'i tshe sgrub kyi gzungs sngags byin rlabs can 'dis/ tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis smon lam btab/ cho ga lhag chad byung ba dang*// sogs sho lo ka dang yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros nas/ mdun bskyed tshe dpag med la phog ste 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid kyi lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim zhing*/ hrīḥyig kyang 'od kyi gong bur gyur te mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang du bzhag ste shis pa brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// zhes sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub 'di'ang dbang gi nyer 'khor bla ma dro skyid kyis bskul bar/ dbu ru stod kyi dge slong dharma kīrtis gzhu spro lung gi lcang lo can du bris pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ shrī dzwa la dzambu dwī pa aṅkā ra bha wantu//
